instrumentation_note: Primary full-frame/native/extract/render/present boundaries are retained. C/D additionally collect CPU/readback/staging/cell preparation diagnostics. Source-cell comparison work remains inside the complete callback but outside the upload timer; it is reported separately and never subtracted. Older missing fields are unavailable. Host CPU cache totals now include the owned cell snapshot. Controls were measured earlier in the stated order.
interpretation: Complete source-cell reuse, immutable neutral texel, retained staging and four-stream hashing were measured in D then C order. Evidence consistency passed all five comparisons; native performance acceptance failed. Four of ten GPU 1768x1084 first-render medians are below 15ms. Rotation still regresses in several scenes against the same current Host with old arms: street 13.464 versus 10.168ms, city 14.734 versus 11.695ms and dense city 18.437 versus 14.420ms. All ordered negative samples are preserved. Changed visible-cell layouts correctly require cell uploads during rotation. No CPU fallback or quality reduction is used. These are CPU wall timers under the same optional crash debugger, not GPU execution timestamps. Normal unattached execution is checked separately.
